title: Meta-Prompt Optimization for LLM-Based Sequential Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2502.00728v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been employed as agents to solve sequential decision-making tasks such as Bayesian optimization and multi-armed bandits (MAB). These works usually adopt an LLM for sequential action selection by providing it with a fixed, manually designed meta-prompt. However, numerous previous works have found that the prompt has a significant impact on the performance of the LLM, which calls for a method to automatically optimize the meta-prompt for LLM-based agents. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的序贯决策的元提示词优化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）最近被用作智能体来解决序贯决策任务，例如贝叶斯优化和多臂老虎机（MAB）。这些工作通常通过为LLM提供一个固定的、人工设计的元提示词来完成序贯动作选择。然而，许多先前的研究发现，提示词对LLM的性能有显著影响，这就需要一种方法来自动优化基于LLM的智能体的元提示词。遗憾的是，在基于LLM的序贯决策过程中，奖励观测的非平稳性使得元提示词优化极具挑战性。为了应对这一挑战，我们从对抗性老虎机算法中汲取灵感，这类算法天生能够处理非平稳的奖励观测。在此基础上，我们提出了用于提示词优化的指数权重算法（EXPO），以自动优化……
tldr: 该论文提出EXPO算法，借鉴对抗性老虎机算法处理非平稳奖励观测的能力，实现基于大语言模型的序贯决策智能体元提示词的自动优化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EXPO, an exponential-weight algorithm for prompt optimization inspired by adversarial bandit algorithms, to automatically optimize meta-prompts for LLM-based sequential decision-making agents despite non-stationary reward observations.
